# CR-002 — Login rate-limit protection + codegen hand-fix guard / การป้องกัน rate limiter + กัน codegen ทับ security fix

**Status:** approved (Boss, 2026-08-09 — direct order in planning session) · **Mode:** DDD
**Plan ref:** SmartGift `docs/implementation-plan-2026-08-09.md` §5 (ZUMP01 Phase 1) · **Checklist ref:** `docs/INTEGRATION-CHECKLISTS.md` §0

**⚠️ Scope revision at merge (2026-08-09):** Part 1 (strict fail-closed) turned out to be
**already superseded on `origin/main` by PR #116**, which enforces the login limit at all
times via an in-process fallback counter when Redis is unreachable — bounded brute-force
protection that cannot re-create the app-wide login outage (see `docs/log.md` 2026-08-04
entries for the recorded decision). This CR therefore **adopts #116's rate-limit
implementation unchanged** and delivers Part 2 (the codegen guard) only. A live, verified
Upstash Redis (`easy-snipe-147391`, PONG-verified 2026-08-09) backs the primary path.
ส่วนที่ 1 (fail-closed แบบเข้ม) ถูกแทนที่โดย PR #116 บน origin/main แล้ว — Redis เป็นหลัก + ตัวนับใน process
เมื่อ Redis ล่ม ยังกัน brute-force ได้แบบมีเพดาน แต่ไม่มีทางทำให้ login ล่มทั้งระบบซ้ำ incident เดิม
CR นี้จึงรับ implementation ของ #116 มาใช้ตามเดิม และส่งมอบเฉพาะส่วนที่ 2 (codegen guard)

## Problem / ปัญหา

1. `checkLoginRateLimit` (`src/lib/rateLimit.js`) has run **fail-open since 2026-07-20**:
   the Upstash Redis instance behind `UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL` was deleted, and the original
   fail-closed behaviour bricked login app-wide, so it was flipped open as an incident
   mitigation. Brute-force protection on login is currently NOT enforced.
   `checkLoginRateLimit` วิ่งแบบ fail-open ตั้งแต่ 2026-07-20 — การป้องกัน brute-force บน login ไม่ทำงานเลยตอนนี้
2. `npm run msp:compose` promotes generated code onto `manifest.target_file` unconditionally.
   `src/app/api/pos/orders/route.js` carries **security hand-fixes landed after codegen**
   (zod validation `3aae8eb`, error-leak sweep `ab7d18c`, guestCount `f3e4640`) and its
   FEAT-006-orders micro-task outputs are **missing from disk** — the pipeline cannot
   reproduce those fixes, so a naive regenerate+compose would revert them. Today the only
   protection is human memory. (Investigated 2026-08-09: `pos/tables/merge/route.js` was
   suspected too, but its hand-fixes turn out to be already reconciled into its outputs —
   composing it today reproduces the live file exactly, so it is deliberately not locked.)
   composer ทับ target file โดยไม่ตรวจอะไร — security fix ที่แก้มือไว้ใน `pos/orders` จะถูกย้อนเงียบๆ ถ้าใครรัน compose ซ้ำ เพราะ outputs ต้นทางหายจากดิสก์แล้ว

## Change / การแก้

| # | File | Change |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `src/lib/rateLimit.js` | `checkLoginRateLimit` fails **closed**: throws `RATE_LIMIT_UNAVAILABLE` when Redis is unconfigured or unreachable. `checkRateLimit` (per-tenant API quota) stays fail-open **by design** — quota is availability-tolerant, login auth is not. |
| 2 | `src/lib/rateLimit.test.js` | Flip the two fail-open assertions to fail-closed (rejects); keep reachable-Redis behaviour tests. |
| 3 | `handfixed.lock.json` (new, repo root) | Manifest of hand-fixed codegen targets with reason + evidence. Seeded with `src/app/api/pos/orders/route.js` (3 post-codegen security commits + unreproducible outputs). `pos/tables/merge` and `pos/delivery/orders` are NOT locked — both verified reproducible/identical as of 2026-08-09. |
| 4 | `scripts/msp/composer-route.mjs` | Before promotion, abort (exit 3) if `target_file` is in `handfixed.lock.json`. Generated output is still written to `.generated.js` for diffing. Deliberate bypass: `HANDFIXED_OVERRIDE=1`. |
| 5 | `scripts/msp/check-handfixed.mjs` (new) + `package.json` (`msp:handfixed`) | Clobber detector: fails if a locked file is missing or byte-identical to its `.generated.js` sibling (the signature of a codegen overwrite). |
| 6 | `.husky/pre-commit` | Run `npm run msp:handfixed` after `msp:check` — the guard is machine-enforced at commit time, not a convention. |

## Acceptance Criteria / เกณฑ์ยอมรับ

- **AC1:** Given Redis unconfigured or erroring, When `checkLoginRateLimit` runs, Then it throws
  (`code: RATE_LIMIT_UNAVAILABLE`) and login is blocked — with regression tests.
- **AC2:** Given a reachable Redis, limits behave as before (5 attempts / 15 min).
- **AC3:** Given `msp:compose` targeting a locked file, Then it exits non-zero without touching
  the target, and says why + how to proceed.
- **AC4:** Given a locked file whose content equals its `.generated.js`, Then `msp:handfixed`
  (and therefore pre-commit) fails.
- **AC5:** Full vitest suite green.

## Deploy gate / เงื่อนไขก่อน deploy — ⚠️ สำคัญ

**Merging this branch before Redis is restored will brick login again** (the 2026-07-13..20
incident). Per `INTEGRATION-CHECKLISTS.md` §0, the sequence is strict:
**merge branch นี้ก่อน Redis พร้อม = login พังทั้งระบบซ้ำรอยเดิม** ลำดับบังคับคือ:

1. Boss provisions a new Upstash Redis; sets `UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL`/`TOKEN` on Vercel
   (Production + Preview; beware pasted `\r\n` — verify with `vercel env pull` + `cat -A`).
2. `curl <REST_URL>/ping` returns `{"result":"PONG"}`.
3. Redeploy so env vars are picked up.
4. **Only then** merge this branch and deploy it.
5. Post-deploy smoke: 6th bad login within 15 min is rejected; runtime logs show no
   `[RateLimit]` errors.

## Out of scope / นอกขอบเขต

Provisioning the Redis instance itself (Boss/credentials), `checkRateLimit` quota semantics,
`src/lib/redis.js` `getOrSet` cache path (fail-open by design, per checklist sanity-check item).
